BiblicalUsage: Bamah is the name Ezekiel gives to the high place itself. God asks what the high place is to which Israel goes, and the name sticks to it.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God names the sin plainly so His people cannot pretend it is worship, and the place called Bamah stands as a rebuke to every altar He never commanded.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
